semantics.exhaustion: Reach a bounded fixed point for the current exact-head evidence and authorized deterministic derivations; do not create semantic noise after NOOP.
semantics.ash: Reduce the completed pass to durable provenance-bound receipts, exact head/tree, causal dependencies, unresolved remainder, and next admissible actions.
semantics.regeneration: Rebootstrap from canonical repository evidence and the persisted ash state; reconstruct rather than inherit unverified chat or cache state.
semantics.reflexivity: Terminal observations may become evidence inputs to the next pass, never implicit authority.
semantics.causality: Causal dependencies govern admissibility; execution sequence is only a projection.

fixed_point.condition: No newly authorized semantic delta remains after exact-head reobservation.

fail_closed: missing independent human review where required

product_owner_authorization.scope: repository-internal implementation and activation through reviewed history-preserving changes
product_owner_authorization.statement: Lass es sich in seiner eigenen Struktur reflexiv erschöpfen und sich selbst zugleich wieder regenerieren. So wie Ikarus und Phönix aus der Asche zugleich.
